## Purpose

What changes, and why?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts` and `npm run check`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] No personal images, private paths, credentials or generated HTML in the diff
- [ ] Browser testing described accurately (or explicitly not performed)

## Limits / follow-up

Note known risks and what still needs owner review. Do not merge, deploy or change visibility automatically.
